phone.title: Sign in
phone.subtitle: Use your Telegram account to continue
phone.label: Phone number (+country code)
phone.terms: By continuing, you agree to our <terms>Terms of Service</terms>

qr.title: Quick Sign in with QR
qr.subtitle: Scan with your Telegram mobile app
qr.step2: Go to Settings > Devices > Link Desktop Device
qr.step3: Point your phone camera at this screen
qr.expired: QR code expired. Click to refresh.
qr.switchPhone: Log in with phone number instead
qr.openedTelegramToast: Opening Telegram... Please confirm the login request in the app.

otp.title: Verify your number
otp.subtitle: We sent a code to <phone>{{phone}}</phone>

delivery.appTitle: Code sent to your Telegram app
delivery.appStep1: Open your official Telegram app (iOS / Android / Desktop)
delivery.appStep2: Look for a message from Telegram (the account with the blue shield icon)
delivery.appStep3: The code will be a 5-digit number in that chat
delivery.appDesc: Telegram sent the code to your existing Telegram account — not via SMS.
delivery.smsDesc: We sent an SMS text message with your login code to {{phone}}.
delivery.emailDesc: Telegram sent a verification code to {{email}}.
delivery.callDesc: Telegram is calling {{phone}} to dictate your verification code.

resend.unavailableToast: Can't resend via SMS. Check your Telegram app for the code.

otp.tryQr: No code received? Try QR code login instead

password.title: Two-Step Verification
password.subtitle: Your account has an additional cloud password
password.label: Cloud password

toasts.codeSentApp: Verification code sent to your Telegram app!
toasts.codeSentSms: Verification code sent via SMS to your phone!
toasts.codeSentEmail: Verification code sent to your email!

errors.sendCodeFailed: Failed to send code. Make sure your country code is included.
errors.phoneNumberInvalid: The phone number is invalid. Make sure to include the '+' and country code (e.g. +91XXXXXXXXXX).
errors.phoneNumberBanned: This phone number has been banned by Telegram.
errors.phoneFlood: Too many attempts with this phone number. Please wait before trying again, or scan the QR code to log in.
errors.sendCodeUnavailable: SMS sending is currently unavailable. Please check your Telegram app or use QR code login.
errors.invalidCode: Invalid verification code. Please check and try again.
errors.codeExpired: This code has expired. Please request a new one via SMS or resend.
errors.resendFailed: Failed to resend code. Please wait a moment and try again.

errors.floodWait_other: Too many attempts. Please wait {{count}} seconds before trying again.

errors.incorrectPassword: Incorrect password. Please check and try again.
